summary: Smoke-tested Phase 1 pSEO salary pages (top hub, job hub, 200 leaf pages, city hubs) and confirmed backend regression endpoints. 14/14 pytest cases pass. All 231 new SSG pages render correctly with proper data, JSON-LD schemas, sorting (SF before NY on SE job hub), city-specific FAQs (NY state income tax), 404 handling for invalid slugs, and sitemap inclusion (1812 URLs verified to be >1800). Backend /api/health, /api/billing/plans (Free/Pro/Business), and /api/auth/login admin all healthy.

issues: Hero text reads 'sourced from BLS OEWS May 2024 BLS OEWS data' — duplicated 'BLS OEWS' because SALARY_DATA_VINTAGE constant already contains 'BLS OEWS' and the sentence template prepends 'BLS OEWS' again. Cosmetic only. Suggested fix: change template to 'sourced from {SALARY_DATA_VINTAGE} data' (drop the leading 'BLS OEWS') OR change vintage constant to just 'May 2024'.

action_items: Optional: Fix duplicated 'BLS OEWS' phrase in /salary hero (and any other place rendering 'BLS OEWS ' + SALARY_DATA_VINTAGE).

All 200 leaf pages are SSG via generateStaticParams returning 20 jobs × 10 cities = 200, plus 20 job hubs, 10 city hubs, 1 top hub = 231 new pages, confirmed.
[city] page correctly uses static segment 'in' to avoid collision with [job] dynamic segment. Next.js routing precedence preserves both.

Salary leaf page has all 5 required sections: answer card (p25/p50/p75/p90/YoY), experience-level cards, comparison bars (city vs national vs COL-adjusted), 5-year trend bars, market context with related jobs + related cities, FAQ. ✓
